programs.title: Goodbye Julia
programs.desc: Wracked by guilt after covering up a murder, Mona - a northern Sudanese retired singer in a tense marriage - tries to make amends by taking in the deceased's southern Sudanese widow, Julia, and her son, Daniel, into her home. Unable to confess her transgressions to Julia, Mona decides to leave the past behind and adjust to a new status quo, unaware that the country's turmoil may find its way into her home and put her face to face with her sins.

programs.title: Sweet As
programs.desc: An Indigenous teenager discovers photography during a youth trip in Western Australia.

programs.title: The Movie Show
programs.desc: Margaret Pomeranz interviews cinematographer Don McAlpine about launching his career with My Brilliant Career and Breaker Morant, and the actors, directors and latest film he's worked on.

programs.title: Gulmohar
programs.desc: With only 4 days left to vacate their home of 34 years, the Batra family finds themselves entangled in chaos and uncertainty about the future.

programs.title: The 39 Steps
programs.desc: A man in London tries to help a counter-espionage Agent. But when the Agent is killed, and the man stands accused, he must go on the run to save himself and stop a spy ring which is trying to steal top secret information.

programs.title: The Tracker
programs.desc: Three mounted policemen chase a fugitive in the Australian outback. It's 1922, and their leader is an Aboriginal guide. Disagreements gradually arise within the group, partly as a result of violent incidents, and questions never before asked arise: what divides blacks and whites, and who has the right to rule? Rolf de Heer abandons the singular \.
